definition: [ סַרְבָּל ] noun [masculine] probably mantle (see especially SAC JPhil. xxvi (1899), 307 f. , compare Andr M 74* , with conjecture as to original Persian form; > trousers ; Late Hebrew; Jewish-Aramaic id. , with both meanings, also shoes ; Arabic mantle is loan-word Frä 47 ; Egyptian Arabic shoe is Greek loan-word according to Vollers ZMG li (1897), 298, compare Krauss ii. 412 ); — plural suffix סַרְבָּלֵיהוֺן Dan 3:21 ; Dan 3:27 .
